faq.title: Questions Our Clients Ask
faq.subtitle: Direct answers to what matters most before you start.

q1.a: An integrated suite of 15+ interconnected modules, authentic Arabic design, high performance, and scalability that grows with your organization.

q2.q: Can the suite be customized to our organization?
q2.a: Yes. We fully configure the suite to match your business, org structure, team roles, and terminology.

q3.a: It depends on the size and number of modules. We start with a pilot rollout, then expand as your team is ready.

q4.a: Yes. Authentic Arabic UI with proper RTL design—not just translation—plus full support for Arabic reports and documents.

q5.q: Can it integrate with other systems?
q5.a: Yes. The suite integrates with external systems via secure, documented APIs.

q6.q: How are support and training handled?
q6.a: We provide hands-on training at go-live, ongoing support through multiple channels, and periodic updates.
